feed.title: NPR Topics: Science
feed.subtitle: The latest health and science news. Updates on medicine, healthy living, nutrition, drugs, diet, and advances in science and technology. Subscribe to the Health & Science podcast.

entry.title: These 6 charts show how NIH research funding has been reshaped under Trump
entry.summary: Stories of science funding being cut, labs shutting down and scientists losing jobs have flooded the media under Trump's administration. These six graphics show how those changes have affected U.S. biomedical research.

entry.title: Hurricane Polo fuels fears of landslides in Mexico as Nolo closes in on Hawaii
entry.summary: Southwestern Mexico braced for heavy rain and mudslides after Polo became a major hurricane. Forecasters warned another system headed for Hawaii could cause catastrophic flooding later in the week.

entry.title: There are still nearly pristine coral reefs. They're a blueprint for coral restoration
entry.summary: Coral reefs are under threat right now due to abnormally warm ocean temperatures. Scientists are studying the healthiest reefs in the world in search of ways to help all reefs with climate change.

entry.title: Category 5 Hurricane Polo is 'one of the strongest storms ever'
entry.summary: Hurricane Polo has grown into one of the most powerful Pacific cyclones in decades, and it was expected to skirt Mexico's southwestern coast as a Category 5 storm.

entry.title: This 'fire amoeba' pushes the limit of what's possible for complex life
entry.summary: Scientists have found a species they've named the fire amoeba, which is capable of reproducing at 145°F and continuing to move up to temperatures of 147°F — a record for complex eukaryotic life.

entry.title: AI solved one of math's hardest problems. Humanity learned nothing (so far)
entry.summary: OpenAI beat humans to solving the Navier-Stokes problem, but mathematicians say the AI's solution isn't telling them much.

entry.title: Abortion is on the ballot again as post-Roe policies continue to evolve
entry.summary: Four states will vote on abortion-related ballot measures in November. The measures follow the Supreme Court's "Dobbs" decision, which upended federal abortion protections.

entry.title: What the equinox 'henge' effect tells us about U.S. cities
entry.summary: The fall equinox, which arrives Tuesday in the U.S., brings shorter days, and chances to witness alignment between Earth and the sun. It's a modern version of ancient observances of a celestial shift.

entry.title: This farm raised thousands of pigs for slaughter. Now it's growing mushrooms instead
entry.summary: The U.S. gets nearly a third of its pork from Iowa. One family is making the switch from pigs to more sustainable specialty mushrooms and trying to show other pig farmers how they did it.

entry.title: Poison suspected in deaths of ten lions in game reserve in Tanzania
entry.summary: The lions were found dead inside the Ngorongoro Conservation Area, a popular wildlife reserve in Tanzania. Deaths raise concerns over wildlife poisonings in East Africa.
